status_detail: BluSky AI executed a purchase and sale agreement dated August 26, 2025 to acquire a 36.06-acre property at 1 Hwy 69/Indian Pool Ranch in Walsenburg, Huerfano County for its fifth AI data center location; source says the site can support up to 15 MW and will be developed subject to state and county permitting.
notes: Local news later reported Walsenburg officials were surprised by the announcement, so status is planned/early and dependent on acquisition closing and permitting.

status_detail: Huerfano County Planning Commission packet for case 24-040 Harris Industrial Park listed a proposed 'Data Center, Orion Technology Center' as a 10,000-square-foot facility including basement; county staff noted a data center was not a listed use and would require a conditional use permit in all zones.
notes: County attachment says early-stage uses including solar farm, pyrolysis plant, and data center would use relatively small amounts of water; no capacity MW stated for the data center itself.

status_detail: Jefferson County Board of Commissioners issued a 10-month moratorium on May 19, 2026 for new data center development or rezoning applications, excluding land already specifically zoned through Planned Development and at least 1,500 feet from dwellings. notes: Moratorium indicates county is responding to demand/risk concerns; no original project application or named developer found in county/news searches.
